correctness.rationale: PASS: The algebra has basis 1,x_i,y_ij and J^3=0. Differentiating skew relations kills scalar generator images (c_ij!=1) and square relations kills off-diagonal linear terms (c_ij!=-1). Every derivation then has D(x_i)=a_i x_i+sum b_ij,i y_ij and D(y_pq)=(a_p+a_q)y_pq. D²=D forces a_i in {0,1}, a_p+a_q in {0,1}, (a_i+a_p+a_q-1)b_pq,i=0. Odd characteristic permits at most one a_i=1; characteristic 2 permits all subsets. Admissible b coefficients are removed by shear with denominator (a_i-a_p-a_q)=±1. Algebra automorphism on J/J² must be monomial and parameter-preserving from square and skew relations, yielding exact subset orbits. Rank= r plus number of mixed eigen-one y terms; independently summing allowed b parameters reproduces odd and even characteristic rank polynomials for q=4,5,7 and n=2..5. These normal-form computations are not a substitute for the structural derivation.
